comment: SPEC-023 §Operational §12 (debt #112). The licences a production dependency of the services, the dashboard or the agent may carry: permissive ones, which ask for the notice alone. A package named below is admitted under the licence it names as well as under the list above, for the reason given. A change to this file is a reviewed change.

packages.name: caniuse-lite
packages.reason: Browser-support data, a dependency of Next that its standalone server carries into the dashboard image; CC-BY-4.0, attribution, which the image gives in its THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES: the package, its author and repository, and its licence text.

packages.name: thirty-two
packages.reason: otplib's base32 codec. Its package.json declares no licence; its LICENSE.txt is the MIT licence (Copyright (c) 2011, Chris Umbel).

packages.name: WixToolset.Sdk
packages.reason: Carries Burn's engine, which is the agent's setup's own executable and runs elevated on the endpoint: its code unmodified, its version resource the setup's, which carries WiX's copyright line (SPEC-024 Amendment 2026-11-14, points 9 and 10). Reviewed under SPEC-024 Amendment 2026-11-01, point 1: the package declares its licence as a file, the OSMF EULA v1.1 (wix7), which Manuel accepted on 2026-11-01; its binaries are redistributed under MS-RL, whose reciprocity reaches each distributed file of WiX's own and not the agent.

packages.name: WixToolset.BootstrapperApplications.wixext
packages.reason: Carries the standard bootstrapper application, which the agent's setup runs on the endpoint, unmodified. Reviewed under SPEC-024 Amendment 2026-11-01, point 1, on the same terms as WixToolset.Sdk.
